description: All operational metrics emit labels drawn exclusively from pre-declared bounded enumerations; no unbounded or dynamic label values are permitted.
assertions: all emitted 'command' label values are in declared_label_domains.command
all emitted 'status' label values are in declared_label_domains.status
all emitted 'provider' label values are in declared_label_domains.provider
all emitted 'termination_class' label values are in declared_label_domains.termination_class
label cardinality for each dimension is bounded at declared set size
